person.name: Piyush
person.headline: Future Data Analyst
person.tagline: I turn raw information into clear decisions, polished dashboards, and practical AI-assisted workflows.
person.narration: Welcome! I am Piyush Raj Sharma — a driven Data Analyst and AI Strategist on a relentless mission to bridge the gap between raw data, cutting-edge machine learning, and high-impact business decisions. I don't just process numbers — I extract intelligence, build predictive workflows, and architect powerful visual dashboards that transform complex chaos into absolute clarity. Step into my digital engine and see how data becomes power.

summary: I am building a career at the intersection of data analytics, artificial intelligence, and high-level digital product design. My focus is simple: dissect complex business challenges, organize empirical evidence, and deliver clear, actionable intelligence.

I engineer production-grade dashboards, clean SQL pipelines, Python data workflows, statistical models, and practical AI applications. I care deeply about presentation and clarity, because data becomes truly powerful only when stakeholders can understand and act on it immediately.
My mission is to become a high-impact Data Analyst and AI Specialist who combines strategic business intuition, rigorous technical execution, and automation to solve meaningful global problems.

projects.title: Sales Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: A premium executive dashboard that reveals revenue, region, customer and product performance at a glance.
projects.challenge: Raw sales exports were scattered, inconsistent and hard to explain to non-technical stakeholders.
projects.solution: Cleaned the data model in SQL, designed a clear KPI hierarchy, and built an interactive Power BI dashboard with drillable views.

projects.title: AI Resume Analyzer
projects.description: An AI-assisted resume review tool that compares candidate resumes with job descriptions and surfaces actionable improvement signals.
projects.challenge: Applicants often miss keyword gaps, weak phrasing, and role alignment issues prior to application.
projects.solution: Built an automated NLP scoring workflow that parses text, calculates keyword fit, and returns prioritized feedback.

projects.title: Movie Recommendation System
projects.description: A content-based recommendation engine that suggests movies based on mathematical similarity patterns and user choices.
projects.challenge: Recommendation logic needed to feel transparent and explainable while delivering accurate matches.
projects.solution: Implemented TF-IDF feature extraction, cosine similarity metrics, and a clean Streamlit interface.

projects.title: Customer Segmentation
projects.description: A clustering analysis project that groups customers by behavioral signals to drive targeted marketing and retention strategies.
projects.challenge: Broad customer segments were ineffective for targeted campaign planning and loyalty programs.
projects.solution: Engineered RFM metrics, executed K-Means clustering, profiled segments, and defined clear business actions.

projects.title: Stock Market Prediction
projects.description: A time-series analysis exploring historical price trends, statistical indicators, and transparent model limits.
projects.challenge: Financial forecasting models often obscure risk factors and data assumptions.
projects.solution: Engineered moving averages and trend indicators, compared baseline models, and communicated confidence intervals clearly.

projects.title: SQL Data Cleaning Lab
projects.description: A dedicated SQL repository transforming dirty, unstructured operational data into audit-ready datasets.
projects.challenge: Source data contained duplicates, inconsistent timestamps, null values, and unstandardized fields.
projects.solution: Developed modular SQL scripts using CTEs, window functions, and validation checks for automated quality assurance.

projects.title: Interactive Power BI Dashboard
projects.description: A report experience designed for fast scanning, executive summaries and meaningful drilldowns.
projects.challenge: Users needed both a quick KPI overview and the ability to explore root causes.
projects.solution: Structured the dashboard around decision layers: snapshot, diagnosis, drilldown and action.

projects.title: Student Performance Dashboard
projects.description: A dashboard that highlights academic trends, risk indicators and improvement opportunities.
projects.challenge: Performance data needed to become usable for mentors, not just stored in spreadsheets.
projects.solution: Built a clean analysis flow from marks and attendance to risk groups and intervention priorities.

projects.title: E-Commerce Analytics
projects.description: An analytics case study covering acquisition, revenue, conversion and customer behavior.
projects.challenge: The business question required connecting marketing, sales and retention signals.
projects.solution: Modeled the funnel, identified friction points and presented prioritized growth experiments.
